final: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id), shares AS (SELECT order_count, order_count * 1.0 / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share FROM order_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT SUM(order_count) AS total_orders, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - value) AS average_excess_share FROM shares CROSS JOIN average_share WHERE share > value
